subject: Re: EBP kickoff: energy-based processes -> 3D capture cleanup
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing picture. Katya leads modeling (energy function + RNN sampler), Oyin and Milan split infra and the CUDA build pipeline, Saoirse at 40% on the eval harness. That covers the May 22 denoising milestone if nothing slips.

Budget: I met with Idris on Monday. Idris Osei has verbally earmarked $120k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-19 for this project, which covers the H100 hours for the point-cloud runs plus storage. I'm treating that as committed and sizing the Q3 run plan against it - formal paperwork to follow after the Q3 OKR lock on June 26.

Near-term compute stays on Titan A100 best-effort; we only need reserved capacity once the larger point-cloud sweeps start in July.

One flag: the gcc/CUDA install is fussy (pip3 install -e . assumes a matched toolchain). Oyin is containerizing it this week so nobody burns days on it.

Alina
